notes.title: Hot Fix - Winter Area
notes.content:
[Fixed] Winter Area not loading when coming from outside
[Fixed] not able to to walk into Winter Area even if it is not visible
[Fixed] teleporting through the map when exiting Winter Area

If you encounter any more bugs regarding the winter area ( Frosted Springs ) and the current event, let us know! 

Until then, Merry Christmas and a happy new year everyone ^^

notes.title: The most sweetest time of the year!
notes.content:
Grab some hot chocolate and be prepared!

Our little friend arrived with some little presents, but some have been lost across the icy waters.

Can you help collecting the missing presents? :3

We have added a new little achievement as a thank you ^_^ 

The event will begins on the 18.12 and ends on the 31.12 every year now.

Have fun and a wonderful time you all! <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/cfe1a87a6f1b6969bffedd6a7b4b19e343fc0324.png[/img]

notes.title: It's a small christmas update!
notes.content:
- A little seasonal collectible hunt inside the Winter Biom levels
- Event decoration around the Winter Biom
- A new Achievement has been added
- We added support for upcoming event possibilities in the future

notes.title: Hot Fix - Hot Tub Achievement
notes.content:
We fixed an issue with the Hot Tub, not unlocking the Hot Tub Achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/bd48be7a3b916d6ed337363d9a8afe5b42571c03.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Achievements Arrived!
notes.content:
It only has been less then two weeks since release but here they are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/fc55ff4d1971b0e17a465b12cb800e570d5d6f8a.jpg[/img]

Have fun finding and collecting all achievements. Some will celebrate your progress, some will encourage you to use the level editor and some are just a joy to discover ^^

Besides the new little secrets, we also have been working on a variety of fixes and improvements to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/d4ab4d7075b3d88caeb32249d37345d029f1a41d.jpg[/img]

Here is a list of what has been fixed or changed:

[Fixed] Overworld Map blocks UI Blending
[Fixed] Overworld Map Unlocks now based on Gate Progression
[Fixed] Browser - Level Slots not showing the authors name if they are not befriend
[Fixed] Level 121 - Not possible due to water tiles wrongly placed
[Fixed] UploadWindow - Description not getting set
[Fixed] Upload Level - With correct tags
[Fixed] Return to Main Menu when played Workshop Level
[Fixed] Workshop level still loaded / loading when returning to MainMenu or playing any Overworld Levers
[Fixed] Level Slot Preview Formats in Browser are off
[Fixed] entering campfire starts at random burnstates

[Added] Visual Que for finished / unfinished (solved / not solved) Workshop level
[Added] Comfirmation Window - Clear Level - Editor
[Added] SteamOverlay - Pauses the Game
[Added] 18 Achievements

[Changed] Clear Level Icon -> Trashcan Symbol for more clearance

[Removed] Return to Overworld Button - still available in Pause Menu - Workshop Level

There are several more fixes and changes that are not listed here. We hope you enjoy this update and have a great time solving puzzles!

See you next time ^_^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/1353740320916bab3d0117ca5542b3439cb3f5e2.jpg[/img]

[*] [Fixed] Browser Info Panel -> Delete Button showing Text : "Duplicate" instead of "Delete"
[*] [Fixed] Level unsaved message triggers now only when changes are not saved yet
[*] [Fixed] Cinnamon roll don't really destroy cookies on border

[*]

We are still working on more fixes so feel free to reach out to us, if you encounter critical bugs and more ^_^
Hope you all have fun playing our cute puzzles and enjoy a nice roasted S'More ❤️

notes.title: One S'More is now Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It is finally time to let you all play our full version of One S'More!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/7da28da1ce05bb9840ef16544316083b73972919.png[/img]

We are so excited and can't wait to hear what you think!
Here is what will await you in our game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/5b77b3b1c3db6179c990e32da83a796eecf799e3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Over 100 levels
[*] 5 different biomes to explore
[*] 10+ unique sweets
[*] Full scale Level Editor
[*] Steam Workshop support to share your creations and puzzles
[*] A very VERY cute little Marshmallow who wants to become the most delicious S'More 🙂
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/f2dc5d4862bfaaf8dbdecce039dfd0b7b7ae9aca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/90fc33d8125e1e3eeb83f2c5b5d500ed47d10b97.png[/img]

We can't wait to hear what you think!
Please share your thoughts with us through a Steam Review or give us your feedback directly on our discord community server!

notes.title: Final Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Mallows :3

We are finally bringing you a new content update for our game One S'More!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/211ee6d43788ee68627bea04faa687e9c3347083.png[/img]

This will be the last content update before we are going to work on the release content for september 23rd. 
In this Update, we changed quite a lot of things and we are excited to hear what you think of it!
We replaced a few of the last levels of each Biom and adjusted the overall campaign to ensure a more dynamic experience and a better learning curve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/0de606cca73e235b4767b771caa7efcabf28602c.png[/img]

We cant wait to hear your feedback!
If you want to stay up to date, share your own creations with our ingame editor and to let us know what you think about the game, please join our community server on discord.

notes.title: 🍪 One S'More - Stream 🍫
notes.content:
Can you help an adventurous marshmallow fulfill its dream of becoming a tasty S'More? Watch your mind crumble as you break apart islands and rearrange the whole world to help your little marshmallow friend reach their goal of getting squished between two chocolate cookies.

Try the demo yourself and leave a wishlist! Also consider to follow us on our social media and join our Discord to stay updated!

notes.title: Level Editor Contest - Send us your coolest levels! ⚙️
notes.content:
Hey everybody 👋🏼 

For the duration of Steam Next Fest all levels created in the demo's editor can be uploaded for a chance to win a Steam Key for the full release of One S'More! 🎉

💡 You need to actively upload your created levels by hitting the button in the level browser 

📅 End of the contest is the end of Next Fest on monday,  june 17th

🔥 You can submit more than one level, but you can only win one key 

🔑 Our team will play though all submitted levels and pick their 3 favorits to win a key to the full release game

👤 Your submissions are automatically linked to your Steam Account name for security and fairness reasons 

👾 We‘ll announce the winners here on our Discord! 

📸 Feel free to share screenshots of your levels here or in „share-your-content“

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello fellow Mallows!
We just uploaded our second patch for the One S'More Demo. This Patch features the new Rewind/Undo button, a complete UI overhaul and more! Feel free to send us Feedback via our social media, discord or with our ingame feedback tool.

Tutorial		
	- [ Added ]	Rewind Tutorial
Levels		
	- [ Added ]	A button to rewind/undo your last action
	- [ Changed ]	Early levels are now easier
	- [ Removed ]	The hint button
Level Editor		
	- [ Added ]	Selecting and moving groups of cookies
Other		
	- [ Added ]	Direction preview when hovering over cookies
	- [ Changed ]	Updated the Main Menu
	- [ Changed ]	Complete UI overhaul
	- [ Changed ]	Water impact wave visuals
	- [ Changed ]	Overworld level numeration
	- [ Removed ]	Winter Skin of the Overworld and Character
	- [ Fixed ]	Some game breaking bugs
	- [ Fixed ]	Many Smaller bugs
	and a lot of other things...

notes.title: It's Winter
notes.content:
As the days get longer 
and the weather ice cold
strange, colorful boxes 
start to appear 

Our brave little friend 
wears fabulous coats 
loves jumping around
in sugary snow

And during this time 
of quiet and joy
they think about puzzles 
and chocolaty goods

So get really cozy
and let us jump in 
to help them become 
the S'More of their dreams

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Mallows :3
We are excited to present you the first patch for our One S'more Demo. This Patch contains some redesigned levels, adjusted difficulty curves, quality of life improvements and much more!
Feel free to send us Feedback via our social media, discord or with our ingame feedback tool ^_^  Have a very nice and delicious 6th of december!
